content: Ar anmar bela-bela nue-bemar-wisgubigussoggu, anmar walagwen Atenas-neggweburgi beoye sogsamarsunnad.

Degisoggu, anmar-gwenad-Timoteo an bemarse barmismalad. We-Timoteo, Bab-Dummadga-arbadiid-duled, degi, anmarba Cristo-Gayaburba-Nued-barsogedgi arbadibalid. Anmar, Timoteo bemarse barmisad, adi, be-niga-ogannomalaga, degi, bemar bur-bela-bela Cristoʼgi-bensuli gumalagar.
Adi, bemar we-bonigan-itonanaid-ular, mer Cristoʼgi bengumalagar. Ar bemar wisid, anmar we-boniganbo-garitogega sulesmalad.
Ar anmar bemar-abargi-gudigusgu, anmar bato bemarga sogsagusad, anmar nue-wilemaloye. Ar deyob gunonisunnad.

A-ulale, ani Pablo, ar an nue bemar-wisgubigussoggu, an Timoteo-barmisad. Ar an bemar-wisgubigusad, bemarde amba Jesúsʼgi-bensuli gudimardibeye. Ar an dobe-itosad, abakalegi nia-saila, ibmar-isgana-imakega bemar-binsaed-gaalile. Ar deyob gunonikile, anmar binsa arbanai gusdo.

Emide, Timoteo Tesalónicaʼse-gudiid gannar nonikid. Anmarga gaya-nued senonikid, bemarde Bab-Jesúsʼgi nue-bensurmarye, degi, na be-muchub-muchub nue-sabmarbarye. Anmarga sognonibalid, bemarde nue-sabedgine anmargi binsadiiye, degi, bemar nue-anmar-dakbiye, igi anmar bemar-dakbi gudimoga.
A-ulale, gwenadgan, anmar bonigan-nika-gudiid-abargi, degi, nue-naibi-itoged-abargi, anmar yeer-itononikid, anmar bemar-wisguargu, bemarde Bab-Jesúsʼgi nue-bensuli gudimarye.
Emigindi, anmar bemar-wissoggu, bemarde weyob-gudiiye, we anmar-ogannoged, anmar dula-gudii guegar.
Degisoggu, anmar aku itoged, bemar-ulale, ¿igi anmar Bab-Dummadga doggus-nuedye sogoe? Ar ade, bemar nue-weligwar Bab-Dummad-asabin anmar-imaked.
Mutikidba, ibginedba, anmar Bab-Dummadse ise-egisar gornaid, bitigi bemarse-ataknaed anmar-imaksana gadinye, adi, bemar-bendakega, bemar-Cristoʼgi-bensulid-nikad ogannogegar.
Bitigi Bab-Dummad anmar-Baba, degi, anmar-Bab-Jesucristo, anmarga igar-egaena gadin, adi, anmar bemar-daknamalagar.
Bitigi Bab-Jesús gatik bemar-onasgumai imakena gadin, adi, bemar na muchub-muchub bur bule-sabgumalaga, igi anmar bemar-sabmarmoga.
Bitigi Bab-Dummad, burbale be ogannosmalana gadin, adi, anmar-Bab-Jesucristo bela-eba-nanaimalad-abargi-danikile, bemar-gwage-swilidik, anmar-Bab-Dummad, degi, anmar-Bab-asabin, gutu-naisuli guegar.
